units.spacing: m (bumper-to-bumper, s = centre distance - leader length)
units.cost: dimensionless (pooled-spread normalised, equal weight mean over events)

reference.dataset: Third Generation Simulation Data (TGSIM) I-90/I-94 Moving Trajectories
reference.publisher: U.S. Department of Transportation (ITS JPO / FHWA), DOI 10.21949/1404218

official_column_units.xloc_kf: m (x-coordinate of the vehicle after Kalman filtering)
official_column_units.yloc_kf: m (y-coordinate of the vehicle after Kalman filtering)
official_column_units.length_smoothed: m (bounding-box length, converted from pixels with 1 px = 0.3 m)

reference.checked_against_verification_columns: I-90/I-94 Stationary Trajectories data dictionary (same 12-column schema, same publishers)
reference.conclusion: metric SI; no unit conversion factor is applied anywhere in this pipeline

HV-HV.conclusion: positions and speeds are consistent with metric SI (ratio ~ 1.0, lengths in metres)

HV-AV.conclusion: positions and speeds are consistent with metric SI (ratio ~ 1.0, lengths in metres)

configuration.integrator: explicit Euler, one step per real time delta (0.1 s), leader speed = measured lv at the step start
configuration.initial_condition: first measured sample of each event (s, v)
configuration.parameterisation: theta = LOWER + sigmoid(z) * (UPPER - LOWER), z in R^5
configuration.start_sampling: start 0 = box centre, starts 1..n-1 = seeded Latin hypercube
configuration.batching: all starts in one (n_starts, 5) tensor, loss = sum of per-start costs
configuration.cost_definition: mean over events of [mean(ds^2)/sigma_s^2 + mean(dv^2)/sigma_v^2 + S_VIOLATION_PENALTY*violations], pooled sigma per pair

box_rationale.v0: 5..35 m/s (18..126 km/h): the 88 km/h segment limit plus free-flow headroom; observed follower maxima stay below 30 m/s
box_rationale.T: 0.3..5 s: the Lab Session I range, covering the 0.8..2.5 s literature band
box_rationale.s0: 0.2..10 m: standstill-gap range; the observed minimum spacing is 2.09 m
box_rationale.a: 0.5..6 m/s^2: covers the observed |a| < 3.5 m/s^2 with headroom
box_rationale.b: 0.5..8 m/s^2: the 1.5..4 m/s^2 comfortable-deceleration band with headroom

configuration.spacing_definition: s = Euclidean leader/follower distance - leader length (manifest)

convergence.best_curve_note: running minimum over all starts and steps (non-increasing)
convergence.start_curves_note: one value every 25 steps per start

torch_vs_numpy.ranking_by: numpy total cost (the same function that produces the reported metrics)
